data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure (optional Filters/RV Site amenity, destination, optional dates, click Find a KOA) with all four parameters, but it orders the filter step before the destination step, which differs slightly from the true sequence, and it adds an extra suggestion-pick step and a generic 'Ways to Stay' name; it is still concrete enough to automate.
